headlines.title: 석유최고가격 석 달만에 인하 … L당 150원씩
headlines.summary: 전기·가스 등 공공요금 동결 1조 투입해 2%대 물가 사수 정부가 중동 전쟁 이전 수준으로 떨어진 국제 유가를 반영해 휘발유와 경유 최고가격을 각각 L당 1784원, 1773원으로 150원씩 내리기로 했다. 석유제품 최고가격을 내린 것은 지난 3월 제도 시행 후 처음이다.

headlines.title: 휘발유 150원 내린다 … 최고가 석달만에 인하

headlines.title: 삼계탕 2만2천원 · 냉면 1만8천원 … "더위 식히려다 가격에 열불나"

headlines.title: 대기업서 중기·자영업자로 … 5년새 바뀐 국책銀 부실 주범
headlines.summary: 대기업 부실비율 3분의1로 뚝 중기·자영업자는 꾸준히 상승 경기부진에 건전성 양극화 국책은행 기업대출 부실의 무게중심이 대기업에서 중소기업·자영업자로 옮겨가고 있다. 조선·해운 등 대기업 구조조정 관련 부실은 상당 부분 정리된 반면, 고금리와 경기 부진이 길어지면서 상환 여력이 약한 중소기업과 자영업자 부실이 빠르게 불어난 영향이다.

headlines.title: 환전 대신 달러 쌓는 기업들 … 외화예금 늘어도 환율 고공행진
headlines.summary: 거주자 외화예금 잔액 1122억 달러 개인은 팔고 기업은 달러 곳간 채웠다 원달러 환율 1550원 선 위협 원·달러 환율이 1,500원대 중반을 이어가고 있는 26일 서울 중구 명동의 환전소에서 외국인 관광객들이 환전을 하기 위해 대기하고 있다. 뉴스 1 지난달 국내 거주자의 외화예금이 기업들의 달러화 예금 증가에 힘입어 두 달 연속 늘었다.

key_headlines.summary: The won-dollar exchange rate has remained in the 1,500 won range for nearly six weeks, approaching 1,550 won intraday, as possibilities of US rate increases combine with foreign investors' selling pressure.

key_headlines.title: Record Tax Surplus to Fund Landmark Development Projects Including Gwangju Fab and Southeast AI
key_headlines.summary: The government is discussing channeling tens of trillions of won in surplus tax revenues into 10 major Landmark Projects focused on future growth engines, with final selection expected next month.

key_headlines.title: Corporations Accumulate Dollar Deposits as Won Weakens; Foreign Exchange Holdings Reach 112.2 Billion Dollars
key_headlines.summary: South Korean residents' foreign currency deposits increased for two consecutive months driven by corporate dollar accumulation strategies, even as the won-dollar exchange rate maintains high levels above 1,500 won.

sections.Hot Economy News: The Korean government is intensifying efforts to foster manufacturing AI as a strategic growth engine comparable to semiconductors, announcing plans to invest trillions of won through Landmark Projects in the 2027 budget. Simultaneously, the government is implementing emergency price stabilization measures including a 150 won reduction in gasoline prices and allocating 1 trillion won to combat persistent inflation driven by Middle East tensions and summer weather factors. The won-dollar exchange rate continues to hover near 1,500 won amid expectations of US interest rate increases and foreign investor selling, creating currency volatility challenges for the economy.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The government is establishing a Future Response Fund to create fiscal safety buffers by allocating surplus tax revenues, which are expected to exceed forecasts significantly. June consumer price inflation remains a critical indicator at the 3% level, with concerns about further increases from summer weather patterns and high global energy prices. The US employment report for June and potential Federal Reserve interest rate hikes remain key variables affecting South Korea's macroeconomic outlook, with potential for second-half inflation pressures if weather disruptions occur.
sections.Financial Markets: The Korean stock market has become subject to extreme leverage through overseas derivative products, with Bitcoin exchanges offering up to 150x leverage on KOSPI movements and 50x leverage on Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix stocks, drawing regulatory concerns. Approximately 12 trillion won has been traded in these high-risk derivatives, with warnings about potential liquidation risks for domestic investors accessing unregulated products. The KOSPI's volatility is increasingly influenced by semiconductor sector performance, particularly earnings from companies like Micron, while regulatory guidance now requires banks to issue at least 10% of floating-rate bonds using KOFR as reference rates.
sections.Industry & Technology: Secondary battery stocks are expected to rebound as the US energy storage system (ESS) market emerges as a new growth axis, driven by AI data center expansion straining power grids and creating demand for battery-based solutions beyond electric vehicles. Used electric vehicle sales have surged while overall used car transactions declined, indicating strong consumer interest in EV segment despite broader automotive weakness. HD Hyundai Electric is expanding production capacity and automation to 93% to capture growing demand for power distribution equipment from AI data center proliferation, transitioning from single-product sales to integrated package solutions.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul apartment prices have surged over 15% in the year since the Lee Jae-myung administration took office, defying three rounds of strict real estate regulations, with non-Gangnam districts experiencing over 20% increases as regulations targeting Gangnam backfired. The Eunma Apartment reconstruction project in Gangnam's Daechi-dong is accelerating toward business implementation plan approval as a major redevelopment initiative, poised to become a new landmark with up to 49 floors. High-end rental-to-sales conversion apartments in Gangnam and Yeouido are attracting market attention as conversion periods approach, though recent regulatory changes have created uncertainty for some premium projects.
sections.International Economy: US Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Wash maintained interest rates at 3.50-3.75% at the recent FOMC meeting while signaling potential rate increases, with the removal of transitory language suggesting a more hawkish stance compared to previous communications. US trade representative Jamieson Grieer is emerging as Trump administration's key figure in tariff and trade policy implementation, overseeing major trade negotiations including those with South Korea. The Nasdaq declined by 15 months' worth of monthly losses, with June employment data and Fed communications driving uncertainty, while PCE inflation reached 3-year highs despite some market optimism about price stabilization trends.
sections.AI & Economy: The Korean Economic Federation is hosting a seminar on July 7th to discuss policy responses to employment structure changes from AI proliferation, focusing on balancing productivity improvements with employment stability. HD Hyundai Electric is expanding production capacity with 93% automation rates to capture surging demand for power distribution equipment from AI data center boom, moving beyond traditional power equipment into integrated solutions. The government established a new dedicated division in the Ministry of Industry to lead regional growth initiatives focused on manufacturing AI implementation and regional development policy coordination.
sections.Others: South Korea's small and medium-sized manufacturing production declined 0.9% year-over-year in April, marking a reversal of four months of growth as Middle East tensions drive up energy and raw material costs, increasing business uncertainty. The Trump administration appointed Lance Schroyer, an Oklahoma police officer, to lead the ICE immigration enforcement agency, signaling intensified immigration enforcement policies. The Trump administration's ban on Anthropic's advanced Fable5 AI model faces imminent removal after just 15 days, as the model has been recognized as the world's leading coding model despite initial national security concerns.
